100_Aconitum_ferox.medicinal_uses: Used only after classical Ayurvedic purification (Shodhana in cow milk/Gomutra). Potent analgesic, antipyretic, and cardiac stimulant in micro-doses.
100_Aconitum_ferox.dosage_and_formulation: Anand Bhairav Ras, Tribhuvan Kirti Ras, Mahavat Vidhwansan Ras (8 to 16 mg purified). Prescribed Dosage: 10-20 mg.
100_Aconitum_ferox.precautions: HIGHLY TOXIC in raw state. Never use unpurified. Contraindicated in pregnancy, cardiac arrhythmias, and children.

10_Calotropis_procera.medicinal_uses: Leaves warmed with oil applied locally for joint effusion and swelling. Latex used traditionally for ringworm and stubborn skin lesions.
10_Calotropis_procera.dosage_and_formulation: Arka Taila, Arkalavana, Mahavishagarbha Taila. Prescribed Dosage: 0.5-1 gm.
10_Calotropis_procera.precautions: Latex is caustic and highly irritating to eyes. Ingestion of unpurified plant causes vomiting.

11_Calotropis_gigantea.medicinal_uses: White flowers used for chronic respiratory conditions, dry cough, and metabolic stimulation. Fomentation of leaves relieves knee arthritis.
11_Calotropis_gigantea.dosage_and_formulation: Dhanvantara Ghrita, Arkadi Kashaya, Sweta Arka Bhasma. Prescribed Dosage: 0.5-1 gm.
11_Calotropis_gigantea.precautions: Caution with dosage. Avoid direct ocular contact with latex.

12_Withania_somnifera.medicinal_uses: Premier adaptogen and Rasayana. Regulates cortisol axis, promotes restorative sleep, enhances athletic endurance, improves memory, and reduces neuro-inflammation.
12_Withania_somnifera.dosage_and_formulation: Ashwagandharishta, Ashwagandha Churna (3-6 g with warm milk), Ashwagandha Ghrita. Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
12_Withania_somnifera.precautions: Caution in pregnancy and active hyperthyroidism. May potentiate sedatives.

13_Saraca_asoca.medicinal_uses: Celebrated Ayurvedic uterine tonic. Tones endometrium, arrests abnormal uterine hemorrhage, and relieves painful menstrual cramps.
13_Saraca_asoca.dosage_and_formulation: Ashokarishta, Ashokaghrita, Ashoka Kwatha (15-30 ml). Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
13_Saraca_asoca.precautions: Safe in recommended doses; not recommended during early pregnancy unless guided by Vaidya.

14_Aconitum_heterophyllum.medicinal_uses: Non-toxic aconite species famous as 'Bala Rasayana' for pediatric digestive disorders. Strong anti-diarrheal, stomachic, and febrifuge.
14_Aconitum_heterophyllum.dosage_and_formulation: Balachaturbhadra Churna, Ativishadi Churna (1-3 g root powder). Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
14_Aconitum_heterophyllum.precautions: Distinguish carefully from poisonous Aconitum ferox.

15_Psoralea_corylifolia.medicinal_uses: Golden standard Ayurvedic herb for repigmentation in vitiligo. Psoralen stimulates melanocytes upon exposure to gentle morning sunlight.
15_Psoralea_corylifolia.dosage_and_formulation: Bakuchi Taila (external application), Somraji Taila, Bakuchi Churna. Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
15_Psoralea_corylifolia.precautions: May cause photosensitivity and blisters if overexposed to strong midday sun.

16_Abutilon_indicum.medicinal_uses: Demulcent, laxative, diuretic, and nervine tonic. Leaf decoction or seed paste is exceptionally effective for painful and bleeding piles.
16_Abutilon_indicum.dosage_and_formulation: Atibaladi Churna, Dhatryadi Ghrita, Thuthi Churna (3-6 g). Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
16_Abutilon_indicum.precautions: Generally very safe and well tolerated.

17_Sida_cordifolia.medicinal_uses: Prime Vata-pacifying rasayana. Strengthens muscular and nervous tissues. Extensively used in medicated oils for abhyanga in paralytic disorders.
17_Sida_cordifolia.dosage_and_formulation: Balarishta, Ksheerabala Taila (101 Avartana), Baladi Kwatha. Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
17_Sida_cordifolia.precautions: Contains trace natural ephedrine; avoid massive oral overdoses in uncontrolled severe hypertension.

19_Clerodendrum_serratum.medicinal_uses: First-line Ayurvedic bronchodilator and mucolytic. Relieves bronchospasms, expels viscid phlegm, and prevents seasonal asthma flares.
19_Clerodendrum_serratum.dosage_and_formulation: Bharangi Guda, Kanakasava, Bharangyadi Kashaya. Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
19_Clerodendrum_serratum.precautions: Safe; use caution in hyperacidity due to Ushna virya.

1_Aquilaria_agallocha.medicinal_uses: Aromatic nervine stimulant and cardioprotective. Heartwood paste is applied for relieving cold numbness and rheumatoid arthralgia.
1_Aquilaria_agallocha.dosage_and_formulation: Agarvadi Taila, Chandanadi Vati, Agaru Churna (1-3 g). Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
1_Aquilaria_agallocha.precautions: Rare and protected tree; ensure authentic sustainable source.

20_Pterocarpus_marsupium.medicinal_uses: Legendary anti-diabetic botanical. Pterostilbene and epicatechin promote beta-cell regeneration and insulin sensitivity. Drinking water kept in Vijaysar wood cups is a classical remedy.
20_Pterocarpus_marsupium.dosage_and_formulation: Asanadi Kashaya, Vijaysar Churna (3-6 g), Chandraprabha Vati. Prescribed Dosage: 50-100 ml (Decoction).
20_Pterocarpus_marsupium.precautions: Monitor blood glucose closely if combining with synthetic hypoglycemics to prevent hypoglycemia.

21_Aegle_marmelos.medicinal_uses: Unripe fruit is supreme for gastrointestinal disorders, curing chronic bacillary dysentery and consolidating bowel movements. Leaves lower blood sugar.
21_Aegle_marmelos.dosage_and_formulation: Bilwadi Churna, Bilvasava, Bilva Taila, Pushyanuga Churna. Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
21_Aegle_marmelos.precautions: Overeating ripe fruit may cause constipation in dry Vata constitutions.

22_Bacopa_monnieri.medicinal_uses: Foremost Medhya Rasayana (nootropic). Facilitates synaptic transmission, upregulates acetylcholine, and repairs damaged neurons.
22_Bacopa_monnieri.dosage_and_formulation: Brahmi Ghrita, Saraswatarishta, Brahmi Vati, Brahmi Taila. Prescribed Dosage: 10-20 ml (Juice).
22_Bacopa_monnieri.precautions: May cause mild nausea if taken on an empty stomach; best consumed with ghee or honey.

23_Solanum_indicum.medicinal_uses: One of the essential Dashamoola roots. Powerful bronchodilator and mucolytic, pacifying aggravated Prana Vayu and clearing bronchial congestion.
23_Solanum_indicum.dosage_and_formulation: Dashamoolarishta, Brihatyadi Kashaya, Dashamoola Kwatha. Prescribed Dosage: 40-80 ml.
23_Solanum_indicum.precautions: Safe when used in classical formulations.

24_Santalum_album.medicinal_uses: Supreme Pitta-alleviating and cooling herb. Sandalwood paste clears blemishes and soothes inflammation. Sandalwood oil disinfects urinary passages.
24_Santalum_album.dosage_and_formulation: Chandanadi Vati, Chandanasava, Chandanadi Taila, Sandalwood paste. Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
24_Santalum_album.precautions: Do not consume synthetic perfume adulterants internally.

25_Pterocarpus_santalinus.medicinal_uses: Endemic to Eastern Ghats. Highly prized topical application for melasma, acne marks, glowing complexion, and arresting mucosal hemorrhage.
25_Pterocarpus_santalinus.dosage_and_formulation: Kumkumadi Taila, Raktachandanadi Churna, Chandanadi Vati. Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
25_Pterocarpus_santalinus.precautions: Non-toxic; safe for topical and therapeutic oral use.

26_Plumbago_zeylanica.medicinal_uses: Foremost Ayurvedic Deepana-Pachana (digestive stimulant). Ignites Jatharagni, dissolves Ama (endotoxins), and shrinks non-bleeding hemorrhoids.
26_Plumbago_zeylanica.dosage_and_formulation: Chitrakadi Vati, Chitraka Haritaki, Pippalyasava (0.5 to 1 g). Prescribed Dosage: 1-2 gm.
26_Plumbago_zeylanica.precautions: Avoid during pregnancy (abortifacient potential). Contraindicated in active gastric ulcers.

27_Punica_granatum.medicinal_uses: Fruit rind is a potent astringent stopping bleeding and diarrhea. Seeds build hemoglobin and nourish Rasa and Rakta dhatus.
27_Punica_granatum.dosage_and_formulation: Dadimashtaka Churna, Dadimadi Ghrita, Dadimavaleha. Prescribed Dosage: 20-50 ml.
27_Punica_granatum.precautions: High rind doses may cause mild nausea due to heavy tannin concentration.

28_Cedrus_deodara.medicinal_uses: Regal Himalayan tree known as the 'Timber of the Gods'. Heartwood decoction and oil relieve severe chronic rheumatic pain and respiratory phlegm.
28_Cedrus_deodara.dosage_and_formulation: Devadarvarishta, Mahavishagarbha Taila, Devadaryadi Kashaya. Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.

29_Woodfordia_fruticosa.medicinal_uses: Flowers are the indispensable natural fermenting agent in all Ayurvedic Asava and Arishta preparations. Astringent stops hemorrhages and ulcers.
29_Woodfordia_fruticosa.dosage_and_formulation: Essential ingredient in Ashokarishta, Draksharishta, Dhatakyadi Taila. Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.

2_Clerodendrum_phlomidis.medicinal_uses: One of the Great Five roots (Brihat Panchamoola) of Dashamoola. Reignites cellular digestive fire, combats fluid retention, and assists fat reduction.
2_Clerodendrum_phlomidis.dosage_and_formulation: Dashamoolarishta, Agnimanthadi Kwatha, Chyawanprash. Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.

30_Cynodon_dactylon.medicinal_uses: Holy grass with remarkable hemostatic, cooling, and embryoprotective properties. Fresh juice instillation stops active epistaxis immediately.
30_Cynodon_dactylon.dosage_and_formulation: Durvadi Ghrita, Durvadi Taila, fresh Durva juice (10-20 ml).
30_Cynodon_dactylon.precautions: Wash thoroughly to eliminate dirt before juicing.

31_Elettaria_cardamomum.medicinal_uses: Carminative, stomachic, and aromatic refreshing spice. Clears palate, eliminates foul oral odors, neutralizes digestive spasms, and soothes urinary tracts.
31_Elettaria_cardamomum.dosage_and_formulation: Eladi Vati, Eladi Churna, Draksharishta (0.5 to 1 g powder). Prescribed Dosage: 0.5-1 gm.
31_Elettaria_cardamomum.precautions: Safe in culinary and therapeutic usage.

32_Amomum_subulatum.medicinal_uses: Warming spice that dissolves respiratory Kapha, prevents gas accumulation, stimulates gastric juices, and stops stubborn hiccups.
32_Amomum_subulatum.dosage_and_formulation: Eladi Churna, Sitopaladi formulation modifications (1-2 g seed powder). Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
32_Amomum_subulatum.precautions: Caution in bleeding disorders and active peptic ulcers due to heating potency.

active_phytochemicals: Ricin (toxic protein removed in cold-pressed oil)
33_Ricinus_communis.medicinal_uses: The supreme remedy for vitiated Vata and Amavata. Castor oil acts as an effective purgative that clears deep systemic toxins from the colon and joints.
33_Ricinus_communis.dosage_and_formulation: Eranda Paka, Gandharvahasthadi Kashaya, Castor oil (10-20 ml with warm milk). Prescribed Dosage: 20 gm (Oil).
33_Ricinus_communis.precautions: Raw castor beans contain lethal Ricin; NEVER consume raw seeds. Pure extracted oil is safe.

34_Gmelina_arborea.medicinal_uses: Crucial Dashamoola constituent. Rejuvenating Rasayana that stimulates lactation in nursing mothers, promotes tissue repair, and alleviates febrile thirst.
34_Gmelina_arborea.dosage_and_formulation: Dashamoolarishta, Brihat Panchamoola Kwatha, Gambhari Phala decoction. Prescribed Dosage: 50-100 ml.

35_Tribulus_terrestris.medicinal_uses: Foremost Ayurvedic nephroprotective and reproductive aphrodisiac (Vrishya). Dissolves oxalate urinary calculi and naturally revitalizes testosterone synthesis.
35_Tribulus_terrestris.dosage_and_formulation: Gokshuradi Guggulu, Gokshura Churna (3-6 g), Chandraprabha Vati. Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.

36_Tinospora_cordifolia.medicinal_uses: Named 'Amrita' (Divine Nectar of Immortality). Supreme immunomodulator, blood purifier, antipyretic, and hepatoprotective botanical.
36_Tinospora_cordifolia.dosage_and_formulation: Guduchi Satva, Amritarishta, Kaishore Guggulu, Giloy Kwatha (15-30 ml). Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
36_Tinospora_cordifolia.precautions: Extremely safe; monitor blood sugar if taken alongside anti-diabetic medications.

37_Commiphora_mukul.medicinal_uses: Cornerstone Ayurvedic resin. Guggulsterones actively block the farnesoid X receptor (FXR) to accelerate cholesterol clearance, melt adipose tissue, and reduce osteoarticular pain.
37_Commiphora_mukul.dosage_and_formulation: Yograj Guggulu, Medohar Guggulu, Kaishore Guggulu, Triphala Guggulu (500-1000 mg). Prescribed Dosage: 2-4 gm.
37_Commiphora_mukul.precautions: Always use purified Guggulu. Contraindicated in liver failure, pregnancy, and active skin rashes.

ayurvedic_properties.dosha_karma: Tridoshahara (Balances all three doshas, especially Kapha and Pitta)

38_Curcuma_longa.medicinal_uses: World-famous golden healing spice. Potent inhibitor of NF-kB, COX-2, and TNF-alpha inflammatory cascades. Topical antiseptic and systemic detoxifier.
38_Curcuma_longa.dosage_and_formulation: Haridra Khanda, Haridradi Taila, Golden Milk (1-3 g with black pepper and ghee). Prescribed Dosage: 3 gm.
38_Curcuma_longa.precautions: Caution with therapeutic megadoses if gallstones are blocking bile ducts.

39_Berberis_aristata.medicinal_uses: High berberine concentration renders it an exceptional metabolic regulator, antimicrobial agent, and ophthalmic remedy. Rasanjana eye wash soothes acute conjunctivitis.
39_Berberis_aristata.dosage_and_formulation: Darvyadi Kwatha, Rasanjana, Khadiradi Vati (1-3 g). Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
39_Berberis_aristata.precautions: Avoid during pregnancy due to uterine stimulating potential.

40_Terminalia_chebula.medicinal_uses: Revered as the 'Mother of Ayurvedic herbs'. Gently regulates peristalsis without dependency, clears systemic endotoxins, and rejuvenates tissues (Kayakalpa).
40_Terminalia_chebula.dosage_and_formulation: Primary constituent of Triphala, Abhayarishta, Haritaki Churna (3-6 g). Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
40_Terminalia_chebula.precautions: Contraindicated in severe dehydration, acute exhaustion, and fasting.

42_Syzygium_cumini.medicinal_uses: Jamun seed powder is a gold-standard natural anti-hyperglycemic. Jamboline glycoside arrests pathological starch-to-sugar conversion in the digestive tract.
42_Syzygium_cumini.dosage_and_formulation: Jambavasava, Jambubeeja Churna (3-5 g), Pushyanuga Churna. Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
42_Syzygium_cumini.precautions: Avoid eating jamun on an empty stomach; monitor blood sugar levels.

43_Nardostachys_jatamansi.medicinal_uses: Potent sedative, neuroprotective, and adaptogenic root. Calms hyperactive brain waves, lowers sympathetic nervous overactivity, and induces peaceful sleep.
43_Nardostachys_jatamansi.dosage_and_formulation: Jatamansyadi Churna, Manasamitra Vati, Jatamansi Taila (1-3 g powder). Prescribed Dosage: 2-4 gm.
43_Nardostachys_jatamansi.precautions: Do not overdose; excessive amounts may cause lethargy or nausea.

44_Myristica_fragrans.medicinal_uses: Warm, comforting carminative and hypnotic. A pinch taken with warm milk at bedtime settles racing thoughts and ensures sound sleep.
44_Myristica_fragrans.dosage_and_formulation: Jatiphaladi Churna, Manmatha Ras, Jaiphal paste (250-500 mg). Prescribed Dosage: 0.5-1 gm.
44_Myristica_fragrans.precautions: Narcotic and toxic in large quantities (>5 g). Use strictly within micro-dosages.

46_Cuminum_cyminum.medicinal_uses: Everyday kitchen culinary jewel and digestive stimulant. Enhances nutrient absorption, relieves intestinal bloating, and boosts lactation in nursing mothers.
46_Cuminum_cyminum.dosage_and_formulation: Jeerakarishta, Hingwashtak Churna, Cumin water (Jeera Jal). Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
46_Cuminum_cyminum.precautions: Completely safe in food and medical usage.

47_Celastrus_paniculatus.medicinal_uses: Named 'Jyotishmati' (that which brings light/brilliance to the intellect). Powerfully stimulates neural pathways, improves recall, and relieves neurological pain.
47_Celastrus_paniculatus.dosage_and_formulation: Jyotishmati Taila (5-15 drops in milk), Smritisagara Ras. Prescribed Dosage: 5-10 drops.
47_Celastrus_paniculatus.precautions: Intensely heating. Avoid in high Pitta individuals, acidity, or active bleeding.

48_Andrographis_paniculata.medicinal_uses: The ultimate bitter antiviral and hepatoprotector. Star constituent of Tamil Nadu's famed Nilavembu Kudineer for dengue and viral epidemics.
48_Andrographis_paniculata.dosage_and_formulation: Nilavembu Kudineer, Kalmegh Navayas Loh, Kalmegh Asava (1-3 g powder). Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
48_Andrographis_paniculata.precautions: Extremely bitter taste; high doses may cause gastric irritation in sensitive stomachs.

49_Mallotus_philippensis.medicinal_uses: Specific anthelmintic (Krimighna) against tapeworms (Taenia). The brick-red powder causes rapid expulsion of parasites.
49_Mallotus_philippensis.dosage_and_formulation: Kampillaka Churna (1-3 g with warm water or honey), Krimimudgar Ras. Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
49_Mallotus_philippensis.precautions: Strong cathartic; overdose triggers excessive purgation and vomiting.

4_Papaver_somniferum.medicinal_uses: Ancient potent narcotic analgesic and astringent. Used strictly under classical purification and medical supervision in minute doses. Seeds are nourishing and safe.
4_Papaver_somniferum.dosage_and_formulation: Ahiphenasava, Karpoor Ras (10 to 30 mg purified exudate only). Prescribed Dosage: 30-125 mg.
4_Papaver_somniferum.precautions: SCHEDULED NARCOTIC. HIGH ADDICTION RISK. Regulated strictly by government narcotics laws.

50_Bauhinia_variegata.medicinal_uses: Foremost glandular deobstruent and lymphatic detoxifier in Ayurveda. Melts glandular enlargements, regulates thyroid metabolism, and shrinks ovarian cysts.
50_Bauhinia_variegata.dosage_and_formulation: Kanchanar Guggulu, Kanchanaradi Kwatha, Kanchanar Churna (3-6 g). Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
50_Bauhinia_variegata.precautions: Safe; long-term use should be monitored in hypothyroidism.

51_Solanum_surattense.medicinal_uses: Dashamoola herb famous as a fast-acting bronchodilator. Relieves histamine-mediated bronchial constriction and clears mucous plugs.
51_Solanum_surattense.dosage_and_formulation: Kantakari Avaleha, Dashamoolarishta, Kantakaryadi Kwatha. Prescribed Dosage: 40-80 ml.
51_Solanum_surattense.precautions: Safe; avoid excessive doses in severe Pitta disorders.

ayurvedic_properties.dosha_karma: Pacifies Vata, balances Pitta and Kapha

52_Mucuna_pruriens.medicinal_uses: Natural botanical source of L-DOPA. Crosses the blood-brain barrier to replenish dopamine stores, relieving Parkinsonian tremors and elevating male vitality.
52_Mucuna_pruriens.dosage_and_formulation: Kaunch Pak, Kapikacchu Churna (3-6 g with milk), Vanari Vati. Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
52_Mucuna_pruriens.precautions: Seeds must be boiled in milk or water to peel outer toxic skin before grinding. Do not take with MAO inhibitors.

54_Cinnamomum_camphora.medicinal_uses: Penetrating volatile stimulant. Applied topically in liniments for immediate relief of arthritic pain, neuralgic spasms, and bronchial congestion.
54_Cinnamomum_camphora.dosage_and_formulation: Karpooradi Taila, Karpoor Ras, Amritdhara (15-30 mg internal medicinal camphor). Prescribed Dosage: 125-375 mg.
54_Cinnamomum_camphora.precautions: Use ONLY Bhimseni (natural edible) camphor internally in micro-doses. Synthetic camphor is POISONOUS if ingested.

55_Picrorhiza_kurroa.medicinal_uses: Premier Himalayan hepatoprotective herb. Stimulates liver regeneration, increases bile production, and purges stagnant Pitta through the intestines.
55_Picrorhiza_kurroa.dosage_and_formulation: Arogyavardhini Vati (contains 50% Kutki), Katuki Churna (0.5 to 1 g for liver; 2 g for purgation). Prescribed Dosage: 0.5-1 gm.
55_Picrorhiza_kurroa.precautions: High doses act as a strong hydrogogue purgative; use with caution in emaciation.

56_Acacia_catechu.medicinal_uses: Supreme herb for dermatological disorders (Kushthaghna). Contracts inflamed tissues, purifies blood, and firms spongy, bleeding gums.
56_Acacia_catechu.dosage_and_formulation: Khadirarishta, Khadiradi Vati (chewable for throat/gums), Maha Manjishtadi Kashaya. Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
56_Acacia_catechu.precautions: Astringent action may worsen dry constipation if taken without adequate fluids.

58_Aloe_vera.medicinal_uses: Supreme female reproductive restorative and cooling demulcent. Acemannan accelerates cellular renewal and wound healing while aloin clears hepatic congestion.
58_Aloe_vera.dosage_and_formulation: Kumariasava, Kumari Taila, Fresh leaf pulp (10-20 g). Prescribed Dosage: 0.1-0.2 gm.
58_Aloe_vera.precautions: Avoid yellow latex exudate during pregnancy due to uterine contracting properties.

59_Crocus_sativus.medicinal_uses: The royal antioxidant spice. Enhances cerebral serotonin, imparts a radiant golden glow to the complexion, and acts as a renowned aphrodisiac.
59_Crocus_sativus.dosage_and_formulation: Kumkumadi Taila, Kesar milk, Chandraprabha Vati (25 to 50 mg stigmas). Prescribed Dosage: 250-500 mg.
59_Crocus_sativus.precautions: High doses (>5 g) can cause uterine spasms; safe in culinary micro-doses.

5_Emblica_officinalis.medicinal_uses: The jewel of Ayurvedic rasayanas. Outstanding cellular antioxidant, rejuvenates eyesight, strengthens hair follicles, and neutralizes stomach acid.
5_Emblica_officinalis.dosage_and_formulation: Chyawanprash (key ingredient), Triphala, Amalaki Rasayana, Dhatri Lauha (3-6 g). Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.

60_Strychnos_nux-vomica.medicinal_uses: Potent spinal cord and reflex stimulant in minute purified doses. Used only after rigorous classical purification in cow's milk and ghee.
60_Strychnos_nux-vomica.dosage_and_formulation: Agnitundi Vati, Ekangaveer Ras, Vishatinduka Vati (30 to 60 mg purified). Prescribed Dosage: 60-250 mg.
60_Strychnos_nux-vomica.precautions: LETHAL POISON if raw. Unpurified seeds cause tetanic convulsions and asphyxiation. STRICT MEDICAL PRESCRIPTION ONLY.

61_Saussurea_lappa.medicinal_uses: Aromatic Himalayan root. Relieves bronchial spasms, promotes cutaneous circulation, expels intestinal gas, and treats refractory skin disorders.
61_Saussurea_lappa.dosage_and_formulation: Kushtadi Taila, Khadiradi Vati, Kankasava (0.5 to 1 g powder). Prescribed Dosage: 0.25-1 gm.
61_Saussurea_lappa.precautions: CITES Appendix I endangered plant; procure only from cultivated legal sources.

62_Holarrhena_antidysenterica.medicinal_uses: World-renowned specific for amoebiasis and chronic ulcerative colitis. Conessine alkaloid kills Entamoeba histolytica while bark tannins seal bleeding mucosal lesions.
62_Holarrhena_antidysenterica.dosage_and_formulation: Kutajarishta, Kutajaghan Vati, Kutajavaleha (3-5 g). Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
62_Holarrhena_antidysenterica.precautions: Very safe; excessive dose in acute constipation should be avoided.

63_Syzygium_aromaticum.medicinal_uses: Unrivaled dental analgesic and local anesthetic. Eugenol desensitizes dental nerve endings and exerts powerful antibacterial action against oral pathogens.
63_Syzygium_aromaticum.dosage_and_formulation: Lavangadi Vati, Clove oil (topical application), Eladi Vati (0.5 to 1 g). Prescribed Dosage: 1 gm.
63_Syzygium_aromaticum.precautions: Undiluted clove oil may burn delicate mucous membranes; apply with a cotton dab.

64_Symplocos_racemosa.medicinal_uses: Classic Ayurvedic gynecological astringent. Balances ovarian hormones (FSH/LH ratio), contracts relaxed pelvic tissues, and eliminates stubborn cystic acne.
64_Symplocos_racemosa.dosage_and_formulation: Lodhrasava, Pushyanuga Churna, Lodhradi Lepa (3-5 g). Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
64_Symplocos_racemosa.precautions: Safe; due to high astringency, avoid in severe dry constipation.

65_Randia_spinosa.medicinal_uses: The supreme and safest medicine for Panchakarma Vamana (emetic therapy). Elicits clean therapeutic vomiting without circulatory collapse to purge respiratory Kapha.
65_Randia_spinosa.dosage_and_formulation: Madanaphala Churna (3-6 g for emesis with licorice decoction). Prescribed Dosage: 1-2 gm.
65_Randia_spinosa.precautions: Used primarily under Panchakarma physician supervision.

66_Centella_asiatica.medicinal_uses: Premier brain tonic and collagen stimulator. Enhances dendritic arborization in the hippocampus, soothes neuro-inflammation, and heals connective tissue.
66_Centella_asiatica.dosage_and_formulation: Mandukaparni Rasayana, Brahmi Ghrita, Vallarai Churna (3-6 g). Prescribed Dosage: 10-20 ml.
66_Centella_asiatica.precautions: Extremely safe herb; exceptional for students and elders alike.

67_Rubia_cordifolia.medicinal_uses: The supreme blood and lymphatic purifier (Raktaprasadana). Cleanses stagnation from the micro-vasculature, clears deep acne marks, and gives sparkling complexion.
67_Rubia_cordifolia.dosage_and_formulation: Maha Manjishtadi Kashaya, Manjishtadi Taila, Manjistha Churna (2-4 g). Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
67_Rubia_cordifolia.precautions: May harmlessly tinge urine reddish-brown due to natural anthraquinone pigments.

ayurvedic_properties.dosha_karma: Pacifies Kapha and Vata, increases Pitta

68_Piper_nigrum.medicinal_uses: World's most famous natural bio-enhancer. Piperine enhances bioavailability of curcumin and other phytocompounds by up to 2000%. Cuts through mucus and burns toxins.
68_Piper_nigrum.dosage_and_formulation: Trikatu Churna, Marichadi Vati, Maricha Churna (250-500 mg). Prescribed Dosage: 0.5-1 gm.
68_Piper_nigrum.precautions: Avoid large doses in acute gastritis or bleeding gastric ulcers.

69_Cyperus_rotundus.medicinal_uses: Unrivaled remedy for fever coupled with gastrointestinal discomfort (Shadangodaka). Relieves abdominal cramps, quenches burning thirst, and regulates menstrual cycle.
69_Cyperus_rotundus.dosage_and_formulation: Mustakarishta, Shadang Paniya, Mustadi Kwatha (3-6 g). Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
69_Cyperus_rotundus.precautions: Safe; slightly constipating if taken without diarrhea.

6_Achyranthes_aspera.medicinal_uses: The alkaline ash (Kshara) is the gold standard in Ayurvedic surgery (Ksharasutra) for treating complex anal fistulas. Dissolves urinary stones and suppresses false hunger.
6_Achyranthes_aspera.dosage_and_formulation: Apamarga Kshara, Apamarga Kshara Taila, Apamargadi Churna. Prescribed Dosage: 1-2 gm.
6_Achyranthes_aspera.precautions: Kshara is strongly alkaline; use strictly within prescribed micro-doses.

70_Vitex_negundo.medicinal_uses: The foremost analgesic and anti-inflammatory herbal leaves in Indian medicine. Leaf poultice and steam fomentation (Nadi Sweda) melt inflammatory joint effusions.
70_Vitex_negundo.dosage_and_formulation: Nirgundi Taila, Nirgundi Ghrita, Dashamoolarishta with Nirgundi. Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
70_Vitex_negundo.precautions: External use is universally safe; oral decoction should be taken with guidance.

71_Butea_monosperma.medicinal_uses: Seeds (Palashbeeja) are a classic deworming agent. Orange flowers boiled in bathing water cure summer heat rashes and prickly heat in children.
71_Butea_monosperma.dosage_and_formulation: Palashbeejadi Churna, Palash Kshara, Tesu flower infusion. Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
71_Butea_monosperma.precautions: Seeds have mild antifertility activity; avoid if planning pregnancy.

72_Fumaria_vaillantii.medicinal_uses: Famous bitter cooling febrifuge. The key constituent of Shadangodaka (6-herb cooling water) used in all burning febrile illnesses to pacify toxic Pitta.
72_Fumaria_vaillantii.dosage_and_formulation: Shadang Paniya, Parpatadi Kashaya, Parpata Churna (3-6 g). Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.

73_Bergenia_ligulata.medicinal_uses: Name literally means 'Stone Breaker' (Pashana = Stone, Bheda = to shatter). Bergenin dissolves calcium oxalate crystals and facilitates expulsion of renal calculi.
73_Bergenia_ligulata.dosage_and_formulation: Pashanabhedadi Kwatha, Ashmarihara Kashaya, Cystone ingredient (3-6 g). Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
73_Bergenia_ligulata.precautions: Ensure high hydration while clearing shattered calculi.

74_Stereospermum_suaveolens.medicinal_uses: Major root of the Dashamoola group. Soothes thoracic spasms, relieves intractable hiccups, calms aggravated Vata, and eliminates inflammatory edema.
74_Stereospermum_suaveolens.dosage_and_formulation: Dashamoolarishta, Pataladi Kwatha, Chyawanprash. Prescribed Dosage: 50-100 ml.

75_Piper_longum.medicinal_uses: Premier respiratory rejuvenator and digestive bio-enhancer. The classical 'Vardhamana Pippali' regimen reboots immunological resilience and cures chronic allergies.
75_Piper_longum.dosage_and_formulation: Trikatu Churna, Sitopaladi Churna, Pippalyasava, Talisadi Churna (0.5 to 1.5 g). Prescribed Dosage: 0.5-1 gm.
75_Piper_longum.precautions: Avoid continuous megadoses without milk or ghee due to heating potency.

76_Uraria_picta.medicinal_uses: Renowned 'Sandhaniya' (tissue and bone reunion) herb. Accelerates callus formation in broken bones, strengthens the heart muscle, and stops bleeding.
76_Uraria_picta.dosage_and_formulation: Dashamoolarishta, Prishniparnyadi Kashaya, Angamardaprashamana Kwatha. Prescribed Dosage: 50-100 ml.

77_Boerhavia_diffusa.medicinal_uses: Named 'Punarnava' (that which renews the body again and again). Legendary diuretic and nephroprotective herb that regenerates damaged nephrons and clears edema.
77_Boerhavia_diffusa.dosage_and_formulation: Punarnavarishta, Punarnavadi Mandur, Punarnavadi Kashaya, Punarnava Churna (3-6 g). Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
77_Boerhavia_diffusa.precautions: Extremely safe; safe for prolonged therapeutic administration in kidney wellness.

78_Inula_racemosa.medicinal_uses: The supreme herbal anti-anginal and cardioprotective agent in Ayurveda. Dilates coronary arteries, prevents ischemic spasms, and relieves dyspnea.
78_Inula_racemosa.dosage_and_formulation: Pushkarmooladi Churna, Prabhakar Vati, Hridyadi Kashaya (1-3 g). Prescribed Dosage: 1 gm.
78_Inula_racemosa.precautions: Use caution in hypotension; regularly monitor cardiovascular parameters.

79_Pluchea_lanceolata.medicinal_uses: Celebrated in classical texts as the 'Queen of anti-arthritic botanicals'. Neutralizes inflammatory prostaglandins and relieves debilitating musculoskeletal pain.
79_Pluchea_lanceolata.dosage_and_formulation: Maharasnadi Kwatha, Rasnadi Guggulu, Rasna Saptaka Kashaya (3-6 g). Prescribed Dosage: 100 ml (Decoction).
79_Pluchea_lanceolata.precautions: Safe; best consumed warm with a little castor oil or ginger water in severe Vata.

7_Cassia_fistula.medicinal_uses: Named 'Aragvadha' (disease killer). Considered the gentlest and safest laxative (Mridu Virechana), completely safe even for children, elders, and expectant mothers.
7_Cassia_fistula.dosage_and_formulation: Aragvadhadi Kashaya, Aragvadharishta, Fruit pulp (5-10 g with warm water). Prescribed Dosage: 5-10 gm.
7_Cassia_fistula.precautions: Very safe; adjusts natural bowel movement smoothly.

80_Barleria_prionitis.medicinal_uses: Renowned as 'Vajradanti' (rendering teeth diamond-strong). Leaf juice arrests tooth decay and gum infections while root oil relieves severe lower back and leg sciatica.
80_Barleria_prionitis.dosage_and_formulation: Sahacharadi Taila (supreme for sciatica/varicose veins), Vajradanti tooth powder. Prescribed Dosage: 10-20 ml.

81_Hemidesmus_indicus.medicinal_uses: Famous aromatic 'Nannari' root. Outstanding Pitta-cooling blood cleanser, protects kidneys from toxins, and produces a fragrant, glowing complexion.
81_Hemidesmus_indicus.dosage_and_formulation: Sarivadyasava, Nannari Sharbat, Sarivadi Vati, Maha Manjishtadi Kashaya (3-6 g). Prescribed Dosage: 5-10 gm.

82_Cryptolepis_buchanani.medicinal_uses: Complementary species to Hemidesmus indicus. Purifies deep dhatus, supports milk production in nursing mothers, and neutralizes systemic inflammation.
82_Cryptolepis_buchanani.dosage_and_formulation: Sarivadi Kashaya, Krishna Sarivadi Kwatha (3-5 g). Prescribed Dosage: 5-10 gm.

83_Rauvolfia_serpentina.medicinal_uses: World-famous historical source of Reserpine. Depletes peripheral sympathetic norepinephrine stores, calming violent psychotic agitation and bringing down dangerously elevated blood pressure.
83_Rauvolfia_serpentina.dosage_and_formulation: Sarpagandha Vati, Sarpagandhadi Churna (250 to 500 mg root powder). Prescribed Dosage: 1-2 gm.
83_Rauvolfia_serpentina.precautions: POTENT PHARMACOLOGICAL HERB. Contraindicated in clinical depression, peptic ulcers, and bradycardia. MEDICAL MONITORING MANDATORY.

84_Desmodium_gangeticum.medicinal_uses: Crucial Dashamoola root. Renowned cardiac tonic (Hridya) and Rasayana that relieves Angamarda (generalized muscle and body aches) and stabilizes myocardial contractions.
84_Desmodium_gangeticum.dosage_and_formulation: Dashamoolarishta, Shalaparnyadi Kwatha, Rasnadi Kwatha. Prescribed Dosage: 50-100 ml.

85_Boswellia_serrata.medicinal_uses: World benchmark natural 5-LOX (5-lipoxygenase) inhibitor. AKBA halts leukotriene synthesis, protecting joint cartilage from enzymatic breakdown and easing colitis.
85_Boswellia_serrata.dosage_and_formulation: Shallaki tablets/capsules (500-1000 mg), Shallaki Guggulu, Shallaki Taila. Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
85_Boswellia_serrata.precautions: Remarkably gentle on stomach compared to synthetic NSAIDs.

86_Bombax_ceiba.medicinal_uses: The gum 'Mocharasa' is a renowned astringent that arrests severe internal hemorrhage and dysenteric flux. Stem thorns ground into paste cure stubborn facial acne.
86_Bombax_ceiba.dosage_and_formulation: Mocharasa Churna (1-3 g), Pushyanuga Churna, Shalmali Ghrita. Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
86_Bombax_ceiba.precautions: Safe; astringent properties may mildly firm stools.

87_Convolvulus_pluricaulis.medicinal_uses: Supreme Medhya Rasayana (brain and nervous tonic). Promotes neurogenesis, reduces anxiety and brain fatigue, and stabilizes cognitive function.
87_Convolvulus_pluricaulis.dosage_and_formulation: Shankhpushpi Syrup, Saraswatarishta, Medhya Rasayana, Shankhapushpi Churna (3-6 g). Prescribed Dosage: 10-20 ml.
87_Convolvulus_pluricaulis.precautions: Completely non-toxic; safe for children and adults.

88_Asparagus_racemosus.medicinal_uses: Named 'Shatavari' (she who possesses a hundred husbands). Supreme female reproductive rasayana, potent galactagogue, and mucosal soother for gastric ulcers.
88_Asparagus_racemosus.dosage_and_formulation: Shatavari Gulam, Shatavari Ghrita, Shatavari Churna (3-6 g with warm milk). Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
88_Asparagus_racemosus.precautions: Caution in estrogen-dependent conditions; otherwise remarkably nourishing.

89_Moringa_oleifera.medicinal_uses: Global superfood and deep-tissue anti-inflammatory. Leaves provide bioavailable vitamins, calcium, and iron while seeds purify water and combat systemic inflammation.
89_Moringa_oleifera.dosage_and_formulation: Shigru Guggulu, Moringa leaf powder (3-6 g), Shigru Taila. Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
89_Moringa_oleifera.precautions: Root bark contains alkaloids that can cause uterine contractions; avoid root bark during pregnancy.

8_Zingiber_officinale.medicinal_uses: Celebrated in classical Sanskrit texts as 'Vishwabheshaja' (The Universal Remedy). Dried Shunthi acts as an outstanding anti-inflammatory, digestive kindler, and motion sickness inhibitor.
8_Zingiber_officinale.dosage_and_formulation: Saubhagya Shunthi Paka, Trikatu Churna, Shunthi Churna (1-3 g with honey or warm water). Prescribed Dosage: 1-2 gm.
8_Zingiber_officinale.precautions: Caution with fresh ginger in severe bleeding ulcers or active gallstones.

90_Albizia_lebbeck.medicinal_uses: The supreme anti-allergic and anti-histaminic botanical (Vishaghna). Stabilizes mast cells, prevents histamine release, and halts seasonal allergy flares.
90_Albizia_lebbeck.dosage_and_formulation: Shirishadi Kwatha, Shirisharishta, Shirisha Churna (3-6 g). Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.

91_Oroxylum_indicum.medicinal_uses: Great root of Dashamoola. Baicalein and chrysin constituents impart exceptional anti-inflammatory, cytoprotective, and anti-diarrheal efficacy.
91_Oroxylum_indicum.dosage_and_formulation: Dashamoolarishta, Shyonaka Patra Kwatha, Chyawanprash constituent. Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.

93_Sesamum_indicum.medicinal_uses: The foundational base for nearly all medicated Ayurvedic oils (Taila). Rich in bioavailable calcium, deeply penetrates tissue layers (Sukshma), and nourishes bones.
93_Sesamum_indicum.dosage_and_formulation: Mahanarayan Taila, Ksheerabala Taila base, Til Churna (5-10 g with jaggery). Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
93_Sesamum_indicum.precautions: Heating nature; avoid excessive consumption in hot summer if prone to bleeding piles.

94_Operculina_turpethum.medicinal_uses: The supreme, most dependable drug for Virechana (purgation therapy) in Panchakarma. Cleanses Pitta and Kapha without griping or circulatory depression.
94_Operculina_turpethum.dosage_and_formulation: Avipattikar Churna (contains Trivrit as primary purgative), Trivritadi Ghrita, Trivrit Lehyam (1-3 g). Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
94_Operculina_turpethum.precautions: Black variety (Shyama Trivrit) is harsh; use only the sweet/white variety (Shweta Trivrit). Contraindicated in pregnancy and diarrhea.

95_Ocimum_sanctum.medicinal_uses: Revered as the 'Incomparable One' and Queen of Herbs. Adaptogen, antimicrobial, and immunomodulator that clears respiratory congestion, soothes coughs, and protects from viral infections.
95_Ocimum_sanctum.dosage_and_formulation: Tribhuvan Kirti Ras, Tulsi Tea / Kwatha, Tulsi drops, Sitopaladi Churna accompaniment (2-5 ml fresh leaf juice). Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
95_Ocimum_sanctum.precautions: Mild anti-fertility properties reported with high chronic seed consumption; leaves are universally safe.

96_Cinnamomum_zeylanicum.medicinal_uses: Enhances insulin receptor kinase activity to lower fasting blood sugar. Warming aromatic properties dissolve chest phlegm and invigorate peripheral circulation.
96_Cinnamomum_zeylanicum.dosage_and_formulation: Sitopaladi Churna, Chaturjata Churna, Cinnamon bark infusion (1-2 g). Prescribed Dosage: 1-3 gm.
96_Cinnamomum_zeylanicum.precautions: Prefer true Ceylon cinnamon over Cassia (which contains high liver-toxic coumarin).

97_Vetiveria_zizanioides.medicinal_uses: The supreme natural coolant of Indian medicine. Drinking clay-pot water infused with clean Ushira roots quenches cellular thirst, stops burning micturition, and calms Pitta.
97_Vetiveria_zizanioides.dosage_and_formulation: Ushirasava, Shadanga Paniya constituent, Khus water, Ushiradi Taila (3-6 g). Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.

98_Acorus_calamus.medicinal_uses: Named 'Vacha' (that which unlocks speech). Stimulates vocal cord coordination, sharpens mental clarity, eliminates cerebral toxins, and protects infants from digestive spasms.
98_Acorus_calamus.dosage_and_formulation: Saraswatarishta, Brahmi Vati, Vacha Churna (125-250 mg micro-dose with honey). Prescribed Dosage: 125-500 mg.
98_Acorus_calamus.precautions: Emetic in large doses (>1 g). Use exclusively purified rhizome within small therapeutic micro-doses.

99_Dioscorea_bulbifera.medicinal_uses: Important Rasayana tuber rich in Diosgenin (the precursor used globally in steroidal hormone synthesis). Restores vitality, builds muscle mass, and assists metabolic control.
99_Dioscorea_bulbifera.dosage_and_formulation: Varahikand Churna (3-6 g with milk), Chyawanprash constituent. Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
99_Dioscorea_bulbifera.precautions: Must be detoxified by boiling if wild bitter varieties are gathered.

9_Terminalia_arjuna.medicinal_uses: The supreme cardioprotective medicine (Hridya) of Indian heritage. Tones cardiac muscle, strengthens left ventricular ejection fraction, protects coronary arteries from lipid oxidation, and accelerates bone healing.
9_Terminalia_arjuna.dosage_and_formulation: Arjunarishta, Arjuna Ksheerapaka (boiled in milk), Arjuna Ghrita, Arjuna Churna (3-6 g). Prescribed Dosage: 3-6 gm.
9_Terminalia_arjuna.precautions: Very safe; exceptional for lifelong cardiac health.
